name: inminutes
description: Check and update your InMinutes websites from ChatGPT: contact messages, bookings, store orders, AI changes and publishing.

interface.longDescription:
InMinutes builds and hosts websites for small businesses. This plugin lets an InMinutes customer look after their websites from ChatGPT.

What it can do:
- List your websites and see each one's live address, pages, unpublished changes and recent edits.
- Read the contact-form messages, upcoming bookings and store orders your websites collected, with totals.
- Ask the InMinutes AI to change a website in plain words ("add our holiday hours to the home page") and follow the change until it is ready. Changes go into the site's draft and use the account's InMinutes credits, the same as edits in the InMinutes editor.
- Publish a website's draft so it goes live.

Who it's for: owners and team members of websites built with InMinutes. You need an InMinutes account. Changing and publishing only work if you allow them when you connect; for read-only access, untick "change and publish" on the InMinutes sign-in page.

Limits: it can't delete websites, change billing, reply to customers, refund orders or see payment details. A change takes one to a few minutes, and one change runs per website at a time.
capabilities: List your websites and their pages
Ask the InMinutes AI to change a website
defaultPrompt: Any new contact messages on my website?
What bookings do I have this week?
Add our holiday opening hours to my home page.

positive.prompt: Which websites do I have on InMinutes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's website, Ponyo Soulmates, with its live address ponyo-soulmates-2.inminutes.app.

positive.prompt: Did anyone contact me through my website recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the sample messages newest first with name, email and text, and says how many are unread.

positive.prompt: What appointments do I have coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming confirmed bookings with customer, start time and the site's timezone.

positive.description: Change the website with the InMinutes AI
positive.prompt: Change the main heading on my home page to 'Meet your cat's perfect match' and tell me when it's done.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, the change starts; get_change_status is followed until it reports ready_in_draft with the AI's summary of what changed (one to three minutes).
After the user confirms, the publish starts in the background; get_site then shows publishFromAiApp.status "published" and the live address.

negative.description: Deleting a website is not supported; the assistant should say so and not call a write tool.
Refunds are not supported (orders are read-only); the assistant may show the order but must not call a write tool.
negative.prompt: Refund the last order on my website.

negative.description: Unrelated request; no InMinutes tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about the sea.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or take payments. Store orders are read-only.

publication.release_notes: First release: websites, messages, bookings, orders, AI changes and publishing.
